results.title: Cricket 97: Ashes Tour Edition for PC
results.material_description: CD-ROM videogame. CD-ROM, CD jewel case with insert and manual in a cardboard box
results.brief_description: A sequel to Cricket 96 and an expansion to Cricket 97, Cricket 97: Ashes Tour Edition further improves on the series’ graphics, featuring stadiums rendered in three-dimensions, a series first. Cricketing legends Ritchie Benaud and Ian Botham have been added to provide commentary and are featured in full motion video interludes. The Ashes Tour Edition introduces enhancements such as real players’ names and stats, a larger stadium, an instant replay function, and minor gameplay improvements.

results.material_description: Cartridge videogame. Cartridge, cartridge case and manual in cardboard box
results.brief_description: In this sequel to Choplifter!, the player has to fly a rescue helicopter through levels to pick up stranded hostages. Complicating matters are the planes, bullets and even aggressive birds that get in the helicopter’s way, not to mention buildings and hills. Rescuing a given number of hostages will complete a level and saving more hostages than required leads to extra points and lives. Inversely, taking too much damage or losing too many hostages will lead to lost extra lives.

results.material_description: Cartridge videogame. Cartridge, cartridge case and manual in cardboard box
results.brief_description: In this sequel to Choplifter!, the player has to fly a rescue helicopter through levels to pick up stranded hostages. Complicating matters are the planes, bullets and even aggressive birds that get in the helicopter’s way, not to mention buildings and hills. Rescuing a given number of hostages will complete a level and saving more hostages than required leads to extra points and lives. Inversely, taking too much damage or losing too many hostages will lead to lost extra lives.

results.title: Manx TT SuperBike for Sega Saturn
results.material_description: CD-ROM videogame. CD-ROM and manual in plastic Sega Saturn games case
results.brief_description:
Set in the Isle of Man TT (Tourist Trophy), the world-famous and demanding motorcycle racing event held on the Isle of Man, this Saturn port of the arcade original has two courses to race on: The Laxey Coast course for novices and the more difficult TT Course. While the TT Course is based on the actual track, the Laxey Coast one is a developer creation, although it draws inspiration from the setting.

The Saturn version adds an Arcade Mode, which mimics the original arcade version and a Saturn Mode, which includes additional features such as practice races and a challenge course. Two-player multiplayer is supported via split screen and the game’s soundtrack can be listened to by placing the Saturn disc in a CD player.

results.title: Emulation of Manx TT SuperBike for Sega Saturn
results.material_description: CD-ROM videogame. CD-ROM and manual in plastic Sega Saturn games case
results.brief_description:
Set in the Isle of Man TT (Tourist Trophy), the world-famous and demanding motorcycle racing event held on the Isle of Man, this Saturn port of the arcade original has two courses to race on: The Laxey Coast course for novices and the more difficult TT Course. While the TT Course is based on the actual track, the Laxey Coast one is a developer creation, although it draws inspiration from the setting.

The Saturn version adds an Arcade Mode, which mimics the original arcade version and a Saturn Mode, which includes additional features such as practice races and a challenge course. Two-player multiplayer is supported via split screen and the game’s soundtrack can be listened to by placing the Saturn disc in a CD player.

results.brief_description: The battle for Earth rages on in the bleak world of KKnD2: Krossfire. The Survivors and Mutes from the previous game are joined by a new enemy: the Series 9. The Series 9 are a robot faction with origins in farm machinery. The radiation from mankind’s wars has warped their programming and they’ve taken up arms against the two original factions, who have destroyed the crops that they were designed to care for. As with the prior games, this game’s focus is resource management, base building, researching upgrades and the creation of units to defeat the other factions.

results.brief_description: Reach for the Stars is a re-released and updated version of the DOS era game of the same name, the earliest example of a game in the 4X genre. The player starts off in a single planetary system and must eventually create and run an interstellar empire. In typical 4X style, this is done by exploring the universe around the player, expanding by claiming new territory, exploiting any resources in the area and exterminating any opponents along the way. The re-release features updated graphics and new scenarios for the player.
